audit.whatIsWrong: The layers invert each other. content.win reads Cassiopeia / Skill / Quinn / Quinn / Cassiopeia / Quinn / Quinn; CHAMP_FULL.phases reads Quinn / Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill. The content whys agree with the full chart, not with content.win: whys[0] gives level 1 to Quinn, whys[2] through whys[5] give levels 3 to first item to Cassiopeia, whys[6] gives the two-item stage back to Quinn.
audit.why: A 55% Emerald+ rate over 60 games plus a 0.75s Twin Fang against a 12s Vault says Cassiopeia owns the middle of the lane; the two-item Harrier kite genuinely reclaims it. Only content.win disagrees, and it disagrees with its own prose.
audit.corrected: content.win should read Quinn / Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Quinn, and CHAMP_FULL.phases[6].side should move from Skill to Quinn to match whys[6]. Not proposed as edits — single-word side values cannot move inside the length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns in either layer. The plan hangs on grounding Vault but never says what grounding one Vault is worth.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8. Grounding it at rank 1 leaves Quinn twelve seconds with no disengage against a 0.75s recast — the number is the reason the play works.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) wants.foe[0] attributes the blind to Vault; the blind is Blinding Assault (Q), and neither layer says the blind does nothing to Twin Fang, which is the fact that decides every extended trade. (b) mid says grounding "strips his disengage recast" — Vault has no recast, she leaps off the target automatically. (c) Behind Enemy Lines is a channel and Petrifying Gaze cancels it; that never appears.
audit.why: Riot: Blinding Assault "calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision" — a blind misses basic attacks, and Twin Fang is an ability, so a blinded Cassiopeia loses nothing. Vault: "she leaps off the target and lands near her maximum Attack Range away" — one cast, no recast. Behind Enemy Lines is flagged channel, interruptible by any CC.
audit.corrected: Blind attributed to Blinding Assault and stated as auto-only, the phantom recast removed, and the Petrifying-Gaze-cancels-the-channel line added to spikes[1].text and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls Quinn "he" and "his" in early, mid, whys and every wants entry, then switches to "she" and "her" in spikes[3].text, wants.foe[2] and late.
audit.why: Quinn is female. The inconsistency reads as a copy-paste from another matchup and undercuts trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every field this proposal touches; the remaining occurrences in early, late and the untouched whys need a sweep.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze ends his Vault-in: the instant he leaps to knock you back or steps up to auto, R the cone into his face for the stun and Twin-Fang the duration into a kill.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze ends her Vault-in: R the cone into her face the instant she leaps, and the same stun cancels Behind Enemy Lines outright if she channels it to escape.

edits.before: Pre-place W Miasma on his likely Vault landing/escape path so the grounding denies his disengage, then Twin-Fang him while he's stuck in the poison
edits.after: Pre-place W Miasma on her Vault landing path so grounding denies the 12s disengage, then Twin-Fang her while she is stuck in the poison

edits.before: Vault knockback + blind off your step-up, then nimble-Harrier kite back to max range before your poison ramps
edits.after: Blinding Assault plus Vault off your step-up, then Harrier-kite back to max range before your poison ramps

edits.before: Level 1 he just needs to poke — Vault knockback and Harrier-charged autos chip you while you sit on one ability with no Q poison economy to punish back.
edits.after: Level 1 she just pokes — Vault and Harrier autos chip you while you sit on one ability; her blind stops autos, never Twin Fang, but you have no poison yet.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze ends his all-in: he Vaults or steps to auto facing you, you R the cone for the stun and Twin-Fang the duration into a kill he can't disengage.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze ends her all-in: she Vaults facing you, you R the cone for the stun, and the same R cancels a Behind Enemy Lines escape channel.

edits.before: This is your window. Hold W Miasma for his Vault — when he commits the leap to reposition or knock you back, drop the cloud on his landing so the grounding strips his disengage recast, then chain Twin Fang off the Q/W poison until he's dead. At 6 your Petrifying Gaze answers his all-in: he Vaults or steps to auto, you R the cone into his face for the stun and Twin-Fang the duration into a kill. Your leveled passive speed plus Q's on-hit move speed means his Harrier kite stops opening safe distance.
edits.after: This is your window. Hold W Miasma for her Vault — when she leaps in to knock you back, drop the cloud where she lands so grounding pins her for the 12s the dash is down, then chain Twin Fang off the Q/W poison until she is dead. At 6 Petrifying Gaze answers her all-in: she Vaults or steps to auto, you R the cone into her face, and Blinding Assault does nothing to Twin Fang while she is stunned. Your leveled passive speed plus Q's on-hit move speed means her Harrier kite stops opening safe distance.
